references.phrase: annihilator ideal of some element of M

references.disposition: Existential quantification over the module elements, without imposing minimal-prime or weak-association conditions.

review_rationale: Reviewed the entire associated-prime definition, separated the exact annihilator of an individual module element from the annihilator of a whole module, and selected the commutative prime-ideal meaning rather than weakly associated or embedded prime variants.
